sections_inspected: Entire supplied text, pp. 1–2 / PDF pp. 1–2
scope_outcomes.criterion: A finding requires an anchored passage in which Riley adopts, builds on, qualifies, disputes, or mentions a proposition attributed to Weber or a Weberian position.
scope_outcomes.basis: The inspected text explicitly attributes a position about partial theories of history and the absence of a grand narrative to the Weberian tradition, then challenges that position as a hidden dogmatism.
limitations: The passage names the Weberian tradition rather than a specific work or passage by Weber.
This assessment is limited to the supplied text and does not establish claims about Riley's complete work or Weber's entire reception.

evidence_state.coverage_basis: reader/reviewer report; source bytes do not establish inspection or completeness
blocking_issues: One or more declared finding references lack retained verified evidence
